cases.risk: A branded HTTP200 error must not authorize a scored report.

regression.test: HTTP200 branded runtime errors remain no-go beyond the short retained quote
regression.expectation: Both retained error shapes are terminal, including text beyond the short diagnostic quotation.

control.test: a recovered final document does not inherit an earlier branded runtime error
control.expectation: An earlier error cannot veto the supported final document.

cases.risk: Error-shell recognition must preserve legitimate concise pages and quoted examples.

regression.test: an HTTP 200 request-rejection shell is no-go without classifying quotations or short public pages as blocked
regression.expectation: The actual rejection shell is no-go; quotations and short public pages stay usable.

control.test: ordinary usable runtime remains usable without policy evidence
control.expectation: Policy incompleteness does not alone reject substantive runtime.

cases.risk: Earlier failed responses and third-party failures cannot replace terminal same-document proof.

regression.test: all retained main-document 5xx responses are terminal, including Cloudflare origin timeouts
regression.expectation: Final main-document server errors remain unscored no-go evidence.

control.test: subresource 522, quoted timeout guidance and an earlier recovered 522 do not block the public page
control.expectation: Subresources, quoted guidance and recovered earlier failures are neutral.

cases.risk: Query/fragment identities and browser document tokens must not be lost or borrowed.

regression.test: materialized consent retains exact query and fragment for its California child while document comparison stays normalized
regression.expectation: Child receives the exact original final URL, with historical comparison semantics preserved.

control.test: query-changing consent evidence with a different browser document token stays unknown
control.expectation: A different browser document token cannot bind controls to the target.

cases.risk: An independent consent visit cannot establish a usable runtime session.

regression.test: unusable original runtime ends the attempt with verified lane pointers and no additional artifact reads
regression.expectation: Unusable original runtime fails before report publication and retains bounded verified diagnostics.

control.test: verified independent consent binding is not overwritten by a later runtime DOM from the same URL
control.expectation: Positive controls retain their own verified session rather than inheriting runtime DOM.

cases.risk: Missing, corrupt or cross-source bytes must not create report evidence.

regression.test: verified S3 fallback enforces Lambda artifact checksum and size
regression.expectation: Hash/size mismatch rejects source bytes rather than repairing them.

control.test: transferred artifacts and original S3 artifacts produce the same complete canonical report
control.expectation: Valid local transferred and remote source bytes have equivalent canonical output.

cases.risk: Retained sections can support positives without inventing complete-document absence.

regression.test: summarizePolicySurfaces does not promote joined retained sections to whole-document coverage
regression.expectation: A bounded section set cannot authorize absence findings.

control.test: owned short-policy positive topics survive without authorizing missing-disclosure conclusions
control.expectation: An owned short substantive notice still supports retained positive disclosures.

cases.risk: A strong quote cannot bypass source ownership, fetch or explicit document quality.

regression.test: a strong retained purpose witness cannot override ownership, fetch or quality gates
regression.expectation: Each hard source gate independently blocks quote rescue.

control.test: a navigation-only excerpt does not veto a validated witness from an otherwise usable policy
control.expectation: A short navigation excerpt is not an explicit bad-document verdict.

cases.risk: Failed canonical publication cannot leak stale numeric scores.

regression.test: failed canonical publication exposes no stale API or summary scores
regression.expectation: Report/API/Pulse fail closed on failed publication even with stale stored scores.

control.test: new reports require both real posture scores without rejecting valid independent routes
control.expectation: Valid dual postures remain publishable across independent routes.

cases.risk: Every new scored report needs both genuine canonical posture scores.

regression.test: redirected retained evidence publishes once through assessment, concerns, persisted report, API and PDF
regression.expectation: Exact publication source and score invariants survive redirect and missing-score controls.

control.test: Pulse summary variants expose the same canonical posture scores as API v2
control.expectation: Compact and detailed summaries agree with API v2 on the persisted canonical scores.

cases.risk: Reject findings need completed bound evidence; unknown paths remain neutral.

regression.test: new click policy fails closed for incomplete, unsupported, ambiguous or pre-click evidence
regression.expectation: Unverified or pre-click material cannot produce a Reject finding.

control.test: verified generic Reject click receives the canonical non-essential service presence effect
control.expectation: A verified completed click and classified positive evidence retain the canonical finding.

cases.risk: Repeated requests and overlapping choice paths must not multiply recipient effects.

regression.test: GPC collection scores only the CA posture through canonical concern/policy/findings; overlapping opt-out charges once
regression.expectation: One canonical recipient union is charged once across eligible paths and leaves EU independent.

control.test: v7 restricted or unresolved collection stays neutral while verified CMP contradictions remain independent
control.expectation: Restrictions/unknown purposes stay neutral while independently qualifying evidence survives.

cases.risk: A WCAG finding cannot borrow a different attempt, source, document or child-frame completeness.

regression.test: mismatched independent document proof or timing discards findings and reports limited coverage
regression.expectation: Mismatched original document/time proof prevents a finding.

control.test: main-document positives survive canonical persistence while child-frame coverage stays limited
control.expectation: Main-document positives persist without turning limited child frames into complete coverage.

cases.risk: TLS network failures and missing transport evidence must remain unknown.

regression.test: strict TLS probe keeps timeouts and network failures unknown instead of invalid
regression.expectation: A timeout does not become a certificate failure.

control.test: Pulse represents missing canonical transport-security evidence as unavailable
control.expectation: Missing canonical transport evidence creates neither a clean result nor an invented failure.

cases.risk: Concrete transport findings need retained resource identity and canonical public projection.

regression.test: mixed-content console evidence identifies the HTTP resource instead of the HTTPS document
regression.expectation: The retained insecure resource is identified without treating the HTTPS document as insecure.

control.test: Pulse projects canonical transport-security rows with bounded detail semantics
control.expectation: Supported canonical transport rows survive bounded public projection.

cases.risk: Report, API, PDF, Pulse and MCP must preserve canonical final results without creating findings.

regression.test: seven retained canary shapes preserve consent eligibility through canonical publication and all report projections
regression.expectation: Retained positive/limited consent shapes preserve canonical eligibility across projections.

control.test: completed Light tools preserve one final canonical score and metadata
control.expectation: MCP tools preserve the final canonical result and metadata.
